title: Identify the exact term revision affected by source changes
preconditions: A fresh term r1 links an exact source constant; change that constant without appending any new term revision.

steps.action: Before appending the corrected term revision, inspect health for the stale defining-code reference.
steps.expected_result: The stale record identifies the exact affected term revision as well as the term identity.

expected_result: Identify the exact term revision affected by source changes.
